535	def bde_cusum(x, k=10):
536	    """Brown-Durbin-Evans CUSUM of recursive residuals of the constant-mean model on the ordered series x: the maximum
537	    crossing of the 5% bands +-0.948 sqrt(T-k) (1 + 2 (r-k)/(T-k)); reports whether the path leaves the band and where."""
538	    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float); T_ = len(x)
539	    if T_ <= k + 2: return dict(break_detected=None)
540	    w = np.array([(x[t_] - x[:t_].mean()) / math.sqrt(1 + 1 / t_) for t_ in range(k, T_)])
541	    sig = w.std(ddof=1)
542	    W = np.cumsum(w) / sig
543	    r = np.arange(k + 1, T_ + 1)
544	    band = 0.948 * math.sqrt(T_ - k) * (1 + 2 * (r - k) / (T_ - k))
545	    ex = np.abs(W) > band
546	    return dict(break_detected=bool(ex.any()), first_crossing_index=int(np.argmax(ex)) + k if ex.any() else None,
547	                max_ratio=round(float(np.max(np.abs(W) / band)), 3), T=T_)
548	
549	
550	def break_tests(T, lag=5):
551	    """The pre-registration step: has the book's per-session expectancy (active sessions, label L1) changed inside IS or at the
552	    IS / OOS boundary? Rolling 60-session mean with block-bootstrap bands, BDE CUSUM, HAC Chow tests per calendar year, and the
553	    one permitted OOS aggregate read: the Chow test at 2026-01-01 (it decides the OOS caveat, never a key)."""
554	    rows = np.arange(T.n)
555	    ses = T.session[rows]; net = T.net[rows]
556	    S = np.array(sorted(set(ses.tolist()))); idx = np.searchsorted(S, ses)
557	    per = np.bincount(idx, weights=net, minlength=len(S)) / np.bincount(idx, minlength=len(S))
558	    day = dict(zip(T.session, T.day)); days = np.array([day[int(s)] for s in S])
559	    is_ = days <= IS_END
560	    x_is = per[is_]
561	    years = sorted({d[:4] for d in days[is_]})
562	    chow_years = {}
563	    for y in years[1:]:
564	        before = x_is[np.array([d[:4] < y for d in days[is_]])]; after = x_is[np.array([d[:4] == y for d in days[is_]])]
565	        chow_years[y] = chow_mean(before, after, lag)
566	    boundary = chow_mean(x_is, per[~is_], lag)
567	    roll = pd.Series(x_is).rolling(60).mean().to_numpy()
568	    idxb = stationary_bootstrap_idx(len(x_is), 500, tag="roll")
569	    rb = np.array([pd.Series(x_is[idxb[d]]).rolling(60).mean().to_numpy() for d in range(500)])
570	    lo, hi = np.nanquantile(rb, 0.05, axis=0), np.nanquantile(rb, 0.95, axis=0)
571	    outside = int(np.nansum((roll < lo) | (roll > hi)))
572	    return dict(label=T.label, active_is_sessions=int(is_.sum()), is_mean_per_session=round(float(x_is.mean()), 2),
573	                bde=bde_cusum(x_is), chow_per_year=chow_years, chow_is_oos_boundary=boundary,
574	                rolling60_outside_band=outside, rolling60_points=int(np.isfinite(roll).sum()),
575	                winners_only_boundary=chow_mean(x_is[x_is > 0], per[~is_][per[~is_] > 0], lag) if (per[~is_] > 0).sum() >= 5 else None,
576	                caveat=("IS/OOS boundary Chow p < 0.05: the OOS window is not from the same process; every OOS table carries this"
577	                        if boundary["p"] is not None and boundary["p"] < 0.05 else "no boundary break at 5%"))
578	
579	
580	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- go / no-go
581	TIME_PROXIES = {"sl", "n_events_asof"}   # as-of columns that are calendar proxies (|rho| with the session index 0.93 / 1.00 on the
582	                                         # IS tape: null_tapes_drift, importance). Still in the design matrix of the studies that
583	                                         # were running when this was found (2026-09-29 12:55 UTC), so they are refused at the
584	                                         # candidate, here and in oos_once.py, not removed from Table.asof_columns() mid-run.
585	
586	
587	def go_no_go(res, tf, cpcv=None, pbo_value=None, dsr=None, spa_p=None, boot=None, null_tape=None, columns=None):
588	    """The pre-registered pass rule on a candidate's IS results. Returns (passed, {check: (ok, value)}).
589	
590	    Two items added 2026-09-29 12:55 UTC from the null_tapes_drift refuters (Judge 1's binding fix), both required for a pass:
591	      null_tape  the `checks` dict of studies/null_tapes_drift/tapes.py::null_tape_check(real_diff, tf, rules) (or of
592	                 null_tape_check_from_diffs for a candidate replayed on the certificate tapes some other way, e.g. an online
593	                 learner run on each tape's table): the real-tape kept-vs-skipped difference must exceed the gmm AND segment
594	                 tapes' 95th percentile and the session tapes must carry its sign in >= 75% of tapes. None -> the item fails as
595	                 "not run"; a string -> recorded as the reason and the item still fails (no candidate passes without the tapes).
596	      columns    the as-of columns the candidate reads; any TIME_PROXIES / NOT_FEATURES / label-prefixed name fails the item
597	                 "no_time_proxy_columns" (a rule on `sl` or `n_events_asof` is a calendar rule). None -> fails as "not declared".
598	    Before that date the function had neither item; every study that called it up to then recorded passed=False anyway."""
599	    ch = {}
600	    ch["kept_share>=20%"] = (res.get("kept_share") is not None and res["kept_share"] >= GO["kept_share_min"], res.get("kept_share"))
601	    ch[f"kept_n>={GO['kept_n_min'][tf]}"] = (res.get("kept_n", 0) >= GO["kept_n_min"][tf], res.get("kept_n"))
602	    ch["diff>0"] = (res.get("diff") is not None and res["diff"] > 0, res.get("diff"))
603	    ch["diff_top1_removed>0"] = (res.get("diff_top1_removed") is not None and res["diff_top1_removed"] > GO["top1_removed_diff_min"], res.get("diff_top1_removed"))
604	    ch["kept_mean_slip8>0"] = (res.get("kept_mean_slip8") is not None and res["kept_mean_slip8"] > GO["slip8_kept_mean_min"], res.get("kept_mean_slip8"))
605	    ch[f"sign_blocks>={GO['sign_blocks_min']}/12"] = (res.get("sign_blocks") is not None and res["sign_blocks"] >= GO["sign_blocks_min"], res.get("sign_blocks"))
606	    ch["control_pct>=95"] = (res.get("control_pct") is not None and res["control_pct"] >= GO["control_pct_min"], res.get("control_pct"))
607	    if cpcv is not None: ch["cpcv_p5_diff>0"] = (cpcv.get("diff_p5") is not None and cpcv["diff_p5"] > GO["cpcv_p5_diff_min"], cpcv.get("diff_p5"))
608	    if pbo_value is not None: ch["pbo<=0.2"] = (pbo_value <= GO["pbo_max"], pbo_value)
609	    if dsr is not None: ch["dsr_p<0.1"] = (dsr.get("p") is not None and dsr["p"] < GO["dsr_p_max"], dsr.get("p"))
610	    if spa_p is not None: ch["spa_p<=0.10"] = (spa_p <= GO["spa_p_max"], spa_p)
611	    if boot is not None: ch["boot_ci_excludes_0"] = (boot["diff_ci"][0] > 0, boot["diff_ci"])
612	    if isinstance(null_tape, dict) and null_tape:
613	        for k, v in null_tape.items(): ch[k if str(k).startswith("null_tape") else f"null_tape:{k}"] = (bool(v[0]), v[1]) if isinstance(v, (tuple, list)) else (bool(v), v)
614	    else:
615	        ch["null_tape:evaluated"] = (False, "not run" if null_tape is None else str(null_tape))
616	    if columns is None:
617	        ch["no_time_proxy_columns"] = (False, "columns not declared")
618	    else:
619	        bad = sorted(c for c in columns if c in TIME_PROXIES or c in NOT_FEATURES or str(c).startswith(LABEL_PREFIX))
620	        ch["no_time_proxy_columns"] = (not bad, bad if bad else sorted(set(columns)))
621	    return all(v[0] for v in ch.values()), ch
622	
623	
624	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- self-test
625	if __name__ == "__main__":
626	    import argparse, time
627	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument("--tf", default="5minute"); ap.add_argument("--selftest", action="store_true"); a = ap.parse_args()
628	    t0 = time.time()
629	    T = load(a.tf)
630	    print(f"{a.tf} L1 units: {T.n} (IS {T.is_mask.sum()}, OOS {T.oos_mask.sum()}), as-of columns {len(T.asof_columns())}, active IS sessions {len(T.active_sessions)}")
631	    print("splits:", json.dumps(check_splits(T)))
632	    X, src = design(T); print(f"design matrix {X.shape}, NaN share {X.isna().mean().mean():.3f}")
633	    frozen = T.F.fz_traded.astype(bool).to_numpy()
634	    r1 = score(T, frozen, "selftest/frozen_gate", dict(gate="ST7/ST8 as traded"), script=__file__)
635	    print("frozen gate:", {k: r1[k] for k in ("kept_n", "kept_share", "kept_mean", "skipped_mean", "diff", "perm_p", "control_pct", "loser_recall", "winner_recall_weighted", "sign_blocks", "kept_mean_slip8")})
636	    rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
637	    vecs = [session_vectors(T, frozen, np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask))]
638	    for j in range(5):
639	        kp = rng.random(T.n) < 0.5
640	        score(T, kp, "selftest/random", dict(seed=j), script=__file__, controls=False)
641	        vecs.append(session_vectors(T, kp, np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)))
642	    print("pbo (kept_mean):", pbo(vecs, "kept_mean")); print("pbo (diff):", pbo(vecs, "diff"))
643	    print("effective trials:", effective_trials(vecs))
644	    gain, _ = selection_gain(vecs[0])
645	    print("dsr (frozen, per-session kept net, 6 trials):", deflated_sharpe(np.where(vecs[0]["kept_n"] > 0, vecs[0]["kept_sum"] / np.maximum(vecs[0]["kept_n"], 1), 0.0)[vecs[0]["kept_n"] > 0], 6, 0.01))
646	    print("bootstrap:", bootstrap_ci(vecs[0], draws=500))
647	    print("spa:", spa(vecs, draws=500))
648	    print("break tests:", json.dumps(break_tests(T), default=str)[:1500])
649	    print("go/no-go frozen:", go_no_go(r1, a.tf))
650	    print(f"self-test done in {time.time() - t0:.1f}s; ledger sha {ledger_sha()}")

216	### quant-ml-canon-meta-label-gate (priority 2)
217	
218	**technique.** Meta-labelling: a secondary model over the Foundation primary model, trained on triple-barrier and intraday label variants with return-attribution (|net|) sample weights, uniqueness weights where labels overlap, optional time decay; bagged depth-limited trees and a depth-3 interaction-constrained gradient booster as ceilings, a binned logistic scorecard as the deployable form, distilled to a rule list of at most 8 depth-3 rules.
219	
220	**what_it_answers.** Given that Foundation already chose side and entry, what is P(the trade pays after costs | as-of context) at the SETUP bar, which SETUPs should be skipped, and does a gate trained to preserve the large winners (the user's 'avoid only loss trades') beat the frozen ST7/ST8 rooms gate and the session-matched random control on kept-vs-skipped expectancy, on IS out-of-fold and once on OOS? Also: which label (engine, intraday, symmetric barrier, trend-scanning) yields the most robust gate.
221	
222	**method.** Inputs: features.parquet per timeframe through an allowlist of as-of columns (97 numeric plus one-hot or count encodings of fz_read, fz_gate, fz_block_reason, fz_branch, dir, hv3_dir, card_out_side, last_bos_dir, last_choch_dir, last6_kinds); bars.parquet to recompute labels. Labels, all from bars after the SETUP bar: L0 = the engine net as built (multi-session holds); L1 = Foundation intraday: the same stop / next-CHoCH exit but forced out at the close of the entry session's last bar opening at or before 15:25, priced as the lab does (lab.trade_charges ZERODHA_NFO_FUT on slipped prices, 5 pts per side, lot 65); L2 = symmetric triple barrier: lower barrier = the Foundation stop, upper barrier = entry + 1 x stop distance (and 2 x as a variant), vertical = 15:25, first-touch with the engine's same-bar conventions (stop first, a session's first candle fills at its close); L3 = trend-scanning: for horizons 5..60 bars the t-value of the OLS slope of close after the SETUP, label = sign and |t| at the horizon of maximum |t| relative to dir (the 'large move' the user describes). Primary training label = L1 binary (net > 0); L0/L2/L3 are robustness labels, every gate is evaluated on L1 because that is the book ST13/ST14 will trade (square_off 15:25). Weights: w_i proportional to |net_i| (return attribution), normalised to sum n; class balance by reweighting the 22% winners; time decay c in {1, 0.5} as a sensitivity (study 6 decides whether it is needed); average uniqueness computed from the concurrency of label lifetimes (expected 1.0 for L0/L1 since no Foundation trades overlap; below 1 for L2/L3 with vertical barriers) and used as BaggingClassifier max_samples. Models: (a) BaggingClassifier of DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth 3-5, min_weight_fraction_leaf 0.05, class_weight balanced), 300 estimators; (b) HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_depth 3, max_iter <= 200, learning_rate 0.05, l2_regularization, interaction_cst = the feature clusters from the importance study, monotonic_cst where the hypothesis states a direction); (c) binned logistic scorecard: KBinsDiscretizer (quantile, 4-6 bins) on at most 12 shortlisted features, L1-penalised LogisticRegression, coefficients rounded to integer points. Protocol: the harness splitter (12 blocks, purge by L-specific exit bar, 3-session embargo), nested choice of the skip threshold tau in {0.10, ..., 0.40} inside each training fold by maximising kept expectancy subject to |net|-weighted winner recall >= 0.90; OOF probabilities saved per model and label (consumed by the conformal and sizing studies). IS-OOF evaluation per model: kept net, skipped net, kept-vs-skipped mean difference and permutation p, precision/recall on losers, share of top-decile winners skipped, control percentile from fz_report.random_control on the kept positions per session, CPCV path distribution. Distillation: fit a depth-3 tree and a greedy rule list (<= 8 conjunctive rules, depth <= 3, features from the importance shortlist, thresholds at quantile grid points) to the OOF decision p_win >= tau (not to the labels), report fidelity, re-run the full evaluation with the rule list alone; log every distillation trial in the harness ledger. Freeze: the rule-list JSON, the scorecard JSON and tau with sha, before OOS. OOS once: the frozen rule list, the frozen scorecard, the frozen ST7/ST8 gate and raw Foundation, same table. Also state explicitly why RL is not used: one-step decision, counterfactual observed for every SETUP, no overlap.
223	
224	**leakage_controls.** Feature allowlist excludes fwd_*, fnd_*, fzpos_*, fzpost_* and every final-state column (swing broken flags, room retirement, visit end fields); verified by re-scoring the truncated build (trunc_20250630_120000) and asserting identical predictions for SETUPs before the cut. Labels are recomputed from bars strictly after setup_i and stored in a separate file. Purge by the label's own exit bar, 3-session embargo, thresholds chosen inside training folds only, OOF predictions never reused for training the same model; calibration and conformal quantiles downstream use OOF only. OOS touched once through the frozen JSON; the label variant used for the OOS table is fixed in advance (L1). Charges and slippage in the label so that the gate cannot win by cost avoidance alone; the kept-vs-skipped statistic is the selection criterion, never net.
225	
226	**compute.** Label recomputation from bars: numpy, under 30 s per timeframe. 12 folds x 3 models x 4 labels x 2 weight schemes = 288 fits; bagging 300 trees on <= 5k x 100 about 3-6 s, HGB about 2 s, scorecard under 1 s: 15-25 CPU-minutes per timeframe with n_jobs = 2; CPCV adds about 10 minutes when requested by the harness; peak memory under 400 MB (the feature table is under 10 MB).
227	
228	**libraries.** numpy, pandas, scipy; sklearn 1.7.2: BaggingClassifier, DecisionTreeClassifier, HistGradientBoostingClassifier (interaction_cst and monotonic_cst confirmed present), LogisticRegression, KBinsDiscretizer; joblib; lab.trade_charges and fz_report.random_control / permutation_p imported read-only (no repo writes).
229	
230	**output_as_config.** A "gate" block keyed by design timeframe for ST13 (minute) / ST14 (5minute), in the style of the fz block with value/source per key: {"model": "rule_list", "label": "foundation_intraday_1525", "rules": [{"if": [["n_choch_since_bos", ">=", 2], ["hour", "<", 13]], "then": "skip"}, ... at most 8, each at most 3 comparisons], "default": "take"} and, for the scorecard variant, {"scorecard": {"bins": {feature: [cut points]}, "points": {feature: [ints]}, "skip_if_score_below": s}}, plus "square_off": "15:25" and provenance {"study", "is_window": "2021-10-01..2025-12-31", "script", "sha", "trials", "fidelity"}. The lab side holds only a generic evaluator (AND of comparisons on named feature columns; a bin-and-sum scorecard), no number. The bagged forest and the booster are reported as the ceiling and never shipped.
231	
232	**novelty.** Lopez de Prado, AFML (2018) ch. 3 (triple-barrier method, meta-labelling), ch. 4 (label uniqueness, return attribution, time decay), ch. 6 (bagging with average uniqueness); Machine Learning for Asset Managers (2020) section 3.4 (trend-scanning labels); Joubert (2022) Meta-Labeling: Theory and Framework, J. Financial Data Science, and Meyer, Barziy and Joubert (2023) on meta-labelling architectures, which are the current practice for 'should I act on this rule-based signal'; cost-in-label and rule-list distillation are the lab's own constraints.
233	
234	**Judge 1** feasible 5 · rigour 4 · expected value 3 · keep True — fix: Trap: |net| return-attribution weights on a 15-22% win rate with top-decile winners carrying ~46% of gross turn the training set into ~30-50 outlier trades per timeframe; the nested constraint 'winner recall >= 0.90' is decided on ~15 winners per 5m fold (+-0.1 noise); 4 labels x 2 weightings x 3 models is 24 hypotheses for one question. Fix: winsorise weights at the training-fold p95 of |net| (or use sqrt), publish every kept-vs-skipped number also with the top 1% of winners removed and require the rule to win both ways, choose tau on pooled OOF with a coarse grid, train on L1 only (L0/L2/L3 as one robustness table, never as candidates), merge with study 13 into a single trial family under the harness splitter, and ship only the distilled rule list or scorecard, judged by its own CPCV 5th percentile (not the forest's).
235	
236	**Judge 2** feasible 5 · rigour 4 · expected value 4 · keep True — fix: Merge with decision-making-1 (same reward, same HGB-with-|net|-weights learner) into one script that also carries DM-1's exact depth-limited policy tree; the two studies are near-duplicates and would double the ledger. Winsorise the |net| sample weights at the IS 99th percentile before normalising: on 1m the top-decile winners are 46% of gross wins and ~70 rows, so an unwinsorised weight lets a handful of trades set the model. State the double weighting (|net| x class balance) once and run it as one scheme, keeping the time-decay c=0.5 variant only if the regime-breaks study finds a break inside IS. Report the nested-tau winner-recall constraint as a CPCV path distribution (5th percentile), because each fold has ~57 winners on 1m and ~15 on 5m; on 5m the 12-feature scorecard (48-72 bins on 184 positives) must be cut to <= 6 features. Write the L1 (15:25) label file first and share it with every other study; it is the only training label. Fits: 288 x <= 6 s = 15-25 min, < 400 MB: runs now.
237

326	### decision-making-1-fullinfo-bandit-policy-tree-gate (priority 1)
327	
328	**technique.** Offline contextual bandit with full-information rewards, solved as cost-sensitive policy learning: value-maximising depth-limited policy trees (Athey-Wager / Zhou-Athey-Wager) and cost-proportionate weighted gradient boosting, with the policy value computed exactly (direct method, no IPS) and distilled to a rule list
329	
330	**what_it_answers.** Which Foundation SETUPs to take and which to skip, by regime / time / volume / level / card context, chosen to maximise INR value (not accuracy), and whether the learned gate beats the session-matched random gate and the frozen ST7/ST8 gates on kept-vs-skipped expectancy rather than by trading less.
331	
332	**method.** Inputs: fz_v3/minute/setup_features.parquet (5,326 rows, 118 as-of columns) and fz_v3/5minute/features.parquet (1,012 rows, 143 as-of columns). Reward table per SETUP: r_take = fnd_net (primary variant recomputed from bars with a 15:25 square-off on the entry session, stop as hard floor; secondary = the engine's own exit as built), r_skip = 0. Every gate pi has exact value V(pi) = mean(pi(x) * r_take); baselines: Foundation (pi = take), ST7/ST8 (st7_traded / fzpos_kind), session-matched random at the same per-session count. Learners on IS only: (A) exact depth-1 and greedy depth-2/3 policy trees whose split criterion is the policy value (sum of r_take over the take-leaf), min leaf 100 SETUPs (1m) / 40 (5m), implemented in numpy over ~110 features x 30 quantile thresholds; (B) HistGradientBoostingClassifier on y = sign(net) with sample_weight = |net| winsorised at the 1st/99th percentile (Zadrozny-Langford-Abe cost-proportionate reduction; with two arms and full information this is the regret-optimal reduction), policy = take iff P_w(win) > 0.5, plus HistGradientBoostingRegressor on winsorised net with policy take iff E[net|x] > tau, tau swept post hoc from out-of-fold predictions; (C) distillation: fit a depth-<=3 DecisionTreeClassifier (min leaf 100) to (B)'s out-of-fold decisions and extract <= 8 conjunctive rules; report fidelity to (B) and the distilled policy's own CV value. Selection on IS CV only: maximise kept-minus-skipped mean net subject to kept share >= 20% and kept n >= 300 (1m) / 80 (5m); also report the value with the top 1% winners removed (heavy tail: 1m winners median 1.8k, p90 10k INR). Diagnostics: SHAP (TreeExplainer) on (B) for the drivers; winner recall and loser precision; per-hour and per-regime kept share. OOS once: kept n, kept net, skipped net, expectancy difference, winner recall / loser precision, random-control percentile at matched per-session k (2,000 seeded draws), permutation p, calibration of E[net|x] by decile.
333	
334	**leakage_controls.** Features restricted to the README's as-of columns; the ledger's session-so-far fields (today_net_asof etc.) are allowed because they use exits <= k. Excluded by name: fnd_*, fwd_*, fzpos_*, st7_outcome_gate and all st7_ POST columns, swings.broken_final, events.window_end/end, zones.retired_* and visits.end_* unless bar-conditioned. CV = 8 contiguous session blocks (GroupKFold on session_i, blocks kept in time order), purge = drop training SETUPs whose trade exit date falls inside the test block, embargo = 2 sessions after each test block. tau, tree depth, min-leaf and the kept-share floor are fixed above; any change is a new pre-registration. OOS evaluated exactly once with the frozen rule list; the winsorisation and quantile thresholds are computed on the training folds only.
335	
336	**compute.** HistGB on 4.5k x 110: ~2 s per fit; 8 folds x 2 learners x 3 seeds ~ 2 min; exact depth-1 policy search 110 x 30 thresholds trivial, greedy depth-3 ~ 1 min; SHAP seconds; controls (2,000 draws x 1,026 sessions) ~ 1 min. Total < 10 CPU-min per timeframe, peak memory < 400 MB.
337	
338	**libraries.** numpy, pandas, pyarrow, scikit-learn 1.7.2 (HistGradientBoosting, DecisionTree, GroupKFold), shap 0.49.1, numba (optional for the threshold sweep)
339	
340	**output_as_config.** strategy_13.json / strategy_14.json block "gate": {"kind": "rule_list", "default": "take"|"skip", "rules": [{"if": {"reg_n_choch_since_bos": [">=", 2], "hour_bin": ["in", ["11","12"]]}, "then": "skip"}, ...] (<= 8 rules, <= 3 conditions each), "min_expected_net_inr": tau, "provenance": {"source": "learned on IS 2021-10..2025-12", "script": "<name>", "sha": "<sha>", "cv_kept_minus_skipped_inr": ..., "control_pct": ...}}. Every feature named in a rule must be one the lab can compute at the SETUP bar from the card, the engine events and the bars; the GBM never ships.
341	
342	**novelty.** Athey & Wager 2021 (Policy learning with observational data) and Zhou, Athey & Wager 2023 (Offline multi-action policy learning: exact depth-limited policy trees) supply the value-maximising tree; Zadrozny, Langford & Abe 2003 (cost-proportionate example weighting) and Beygelzimer & Langford 2009 (offset tree) are the bandit-to-classification reductions, which become exact here because the reward of both arms is known (Dudik, Langford & Li 2011's doubly-robust estimator collapses to the direct method). Distillation follows Bastani, Kim & Bastani 2018 (policy extraction into decision trees). This differs from H5 in the objective: H5 fits win/loss; this maximises INR value with the skip reward pinned at 0 and the costs inside the reward.
343	
344	**Judge 1** feasible 5 · rigour 4 · expected value 3 · keep True — fix: Trap: a value-maximising split on heavy-tailed rewards chases the leaf holding the outlier winners (1m p90 winner 10k INR vs median 1.8k), tau 'swept post hoc' on pooled OOF is a selection the ledger must count, and this is study 2's hypothesis run a second time under a different splitter (8 vs 12 blocks), doubling the trials for one question. Fix: keep the 1/99 winsorisation and make the top-1%-removed value a hard pass condition, add a block-wise sign test (kept-vs-skipped > 0 in >= 6 of 8 blocks), log every tau, use the harness splitter, restrict features to study 3's shortlist, and merge with study 2 into one trial family so exactly one gate candidate from the family reaches OOS.
345	
346	**Judge 2** feasible 5 · rigour 4 · expected value 4 · keep True — fix: Merge with quant-ml-canon-meta-label-gate (same reward, same |net|-weighted HGB); keep the exact depth-limited policy tree as the distinct, most config-native learner. Nest tau: 'tau swept post hoc from out-of-fold predictions' selects on all IS OOF outcomes; choose tau inside each training fold as the meta-label study does. Adopt the harness splitter (12 blocks, 3-session embargo; 3 is justified by the 5m room age and vol_med60 memory, 2 is not) instead of 8 blocks / 2 sessions. Keep the kept-share and kept-n floors and the top-1%-removed value; they belong in the harness go/no-go for everyone. < 10 CPU-min, < 400 MB: runs now.

243	    """go/no-go on the nested OOF row with the nested CPCV, the family PBO / SPA, the DSR (n_trials = family size), the bootstrap,
244	    the columns the frozen form reads (harness TIME_PROXIES / NOT_FEATURES refused) and the null-tape checks (the sub-family
245	    finalist is replayed on the certificate tapes; every other form records the reason and the item fails, as the harness requires)."""
246	    res = fin["oof"]; cpcv = fin["cpcv"]
247	    if res is None or res.get("id") not in vecs_by_id: return dict(passed=False, checks={}, reason="no vector for the OOF row")
248	    vec = vecs_by_id[res["id"]]
249	    dsr = dsr_for(vec, fam["n_rows_all_labels"], fam.get("sr_var_family"))
250	    boot = H.bootstrap_ci(vec, tag=f"gate_family|{tf}|{sub}|{fin['model']}|{fin['form']}")
251	    pbo_v = fam.get("pbo_diff", {}).get("pbo"); spa_p = fam.get("spa", {}).get("spa_p")
252	    cols = frozen_features(fin)
253	    nt_arg = null_tape if null_tape is not None else "not evaluated: only the sub-family finalist (best nested CPCV p5) is replayed on the certificate tapes"
254	    ok, ch = H.go_no_go(res, tf, cpcv=cpcv if cpcv else None, pbo_value=pbo_v, dsr=dsr, spa_p=spa_p, boot=boot, null_tape=nt_arg, columns=cols)
255	    return dict(passed=bool(ok), checks={k: [bool(v[0]), v[1]] for k, v in ch.items()}, dsr=dsr, boot=boot, n_fail=int(sum(1 for v in ch.values() if not v[0])),
256	                cpcv_p5=(cpcv or {}).get("diff_p5"), columns=cols)

111	_OPS = {">=": np.greater_equal, ">": np.greater, "<=": np.less_equal, "<": np.less, "==": np.equal, "!=": np.not_equal}

114	def _cmp(series, op, value):
115	    if op in ("in", "not_in"):
116	        vals = [str(v) for v in (value if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)) else [value])]
117	        s = series.astype(object).map(lambda z: None if z is None or (isinstance(z, float) and np.isnan(z)) else str(z))
118	        hit = s.isin(vals).to_numpy() & s.notna().to_numpy()
119	        return hit if op == "in" else (~hit & s.notna().to_numpy())
120	    if op not in _OPS: raise ValueError(f"unknown op {op}")
121	    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series) or pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(series):
122	        x = series.to_numpy(dtype=float)
123	        v = float(value) if not isinstance(value, bool) else float(value)
124	        with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"): hit = _OPS[op](x, v)
125	        return hit & np.isfinite(x)
126	    so = series.astype(object)
127	    if op in ("==", "!="):
128	        s = so.map(lambda z: None if z is None or (isinstance(z, float) and np.isnan(z)) else str(z))
129	        hit = (s == str(value)).to_numpy() & s.notna().to_numpy()
130	        return hit if op == "==" else (~hit & s.notna().to_numpy())
131	    x = pd.to_numeric(so, errors="coerce").to_numpy(dtype=float)
132	    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"): hit = _OPS[op](x, float(value))
133	    return hit & np.isfinite(x)

144	def rule_mask(F, rules, tf):
145	    """(fires, mode): fires[i] = any rule's conjunction holds on row i; mode = 'skip' or 'keep'.
146	    Refuses (PermissionError) a label column, a harness.NOT_FEATURES column and a calendar proxy (time_proxies(tf))."""
147	    rules = rules_for(rules, tf)
148	    modes = {str(r.get("then", "skip")).lower() for r in rules}
149	    if len(modes) > 1: raise ValueError(f"a rule list mixes {sorted(modes)}; use one mode")
150	    mode = modes.pop() if modes else "skip"
151	    proxies = time_proxies(tf)
152	    fires = np.zeros(len(F), dtype=bool)
153	    for r in rules:
154	        conds = r["if"]
155	        if len(conds) > 3: raise ValueError(f"rule {r.get('id')} has depth {len(conds)} > 3")
156	        m = np.ones(len(F), dtype=bool)
157	        for col, op, val in conds:
158	            if col not in F.columns: raise KeyError(f"rule {r.get('id')}: column {col} not in the feature table")
159	            if col.startswith(H.LABEL_PREFIX) or col in H.NOT_FEATURES: raise PermissionError(f"rule {r.get('id')}: {col} is not an as-of feature")
160	            if col in proxies: raise PermissionError(f"rule {r.get('id')}: {col} is a time proxy (drift.json time_proxies, |rho| >= 0.9 with session_idx): a calendar rule, refused")
161	            m &= _cmp(F[col], op, val)
162	        fires |= m
163	    return fires, mode

189	def _frozen_runs(folder):
190	    """Per IS session: prot frozen (no change inside the session and equal to the previous session's last prot) and no CHoCH.
191	    Returns (n_sessions, run lengths of consecutive frozen sessions, per-session frozen flags, position of the last CHoCH session,
192	    the longest CHoCH-free stretch in sessions, the session dates)."""
193	    B = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(folder, "bars.parquet"), columns=["i", "session_idx", "close", "prot", "split"])
194	    if "split" in B.columns: B = B[B.split.astype(str) == "IS"]
195	    E = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(folder, "events.parquet"), columns=["i", "kind"])
196	    S = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(folder, "sessions.parquet"))
197	    S = S[S.split.astype(str) == "IS"].sort_values("session_idx")
198	    sess = S.session_idx.to_numpy(); n_s = len(sess); pos = {int(s): j for j, s in enumerate(sess)}
199	    pr = B.prot.fillna(-1.0)
200	    g = pd.DataFrame(dict(session_idx=B.session_idx.to_numpy(), prot=pr.to_numpy())).groupby("session_idx").prot.agg(["first", "last", "nunique"])
201	    g = g.reindex(sess)
202	    prev_last = g["last"].shift(1)
203	    moved = (g["nunique"] > 1) | (g["first"] != prev_last)
204	    moved.iloc[0] = True
205	    b2s = dict(zip(B.i.to_numpy(), B.session_idx.to_numpy()))
206	    ch_sess = {b2s[i] for i in E[E.kind == "CHoCH"].i.to_numpy() if i in b2s}
207	    has_ch = np.array([s in ch_sess for s in sess])
208	    frozen = ~(moved.to_numpy() | has_ch)
209	    runs = []; c = 0
210	    for v in frozen:
211	        if v: c += 1
212	        elif c: runs.append(c); c = 0
213	    if c: runs.append(c)
214	    ch_pos = sorted(pos[s] for s in ch_sess)
215	    last_ch = ch_pos[-1] if ch_pos else -1
216	    stretches = np.diff(np.array([-1] + ch_pos + [n_s])) - 1
217	    return dict(n_sessions=int(n_s), runs=np.array(runs, dtype=int) if runs else np.zeros(0, dtype=int), frozen=frozen, last_choch_pos=int(last_ch),
218	                longest_choch_free=int(stretches.max()) if len(stretches) else int(n_s), dates=S.date.astype(str).to_numpy(),
219	                prot_last=(None if np.isnan(B.prot.iloc[-1]) else float(B.prot.iloc[-1])), close_last=float(B.close.iloc[-1]), is_bar_ids=set(B.i.tolist()))

268	               dead_sessions=dead, dead_share=round(dead_share, 4), dead_runs=[int(x) for x in dead_runs],
269	               dead_tail_share=round((n_s - 1 - fr["last_choch_pos"]) / n_s, 4), longest_choch_free_sessions=fr["longest_choch_free"],
270	               last_choch_date=(fr["dates"][fr["last_choch_pos"]] if fr["last_choch_pos"] >= 0 else None),
271	               last_setup_time=(str(P.time.max()) if len(P) else None), setups=int(len(P)), setups_per_session=round(setups_ps, 4),
272	               setup_rate_ratio_to_real=(round(ratio, 4) if ratio is not None else None), prot_last=fr["prot_last"], close_last=fr["close_last"],

274	               real_longest_frozen_run_sessions=L, real_setups_per_session=real["setups_per_session"],
275	               healthy=(len(reasons) == 0), reasons=reasons, rule=dict(HEALTH, dead_run_longer_than=L))
276	    if write:
277	        json.dump(out, open(os.path.join(folder, "tape_health.json"), "w"), indent=1)
278	    return out

281	def read_health(folder, compute=True):
282	    p = os.path.join(folder, "tape_health.json")
283	    if os.path.exists(p): return json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
284	    return tape_health(folder) if compute else None

287	def all_tape_folders(tf, gen=None):
288	    """Every built tape folder of the timeframe (and generator), sorted by generator then seed index k (numeric)."""
289	    pat = os.path.join(HERE, "tapes", tf, f"{gen or '*'}_*")
290	    fs = [p for p in glob.glob(pat) if os.path.exists(os.path.join(p, "features.parquet"))]
291	    return sorted(fs, key=lambda p: (_tape_gen(p), _tape_k(p)))
292	
293	
294	def tape_folders(tf, gen=None, healthy=True, n=None, original_only=False):
295	    """The tape set a candidate is evaluated on.
296	    healthy=True (default, the CERTIFICATE set): per generator the first n (= DESIGN_N[tf]) tapes by seed index k whose
297	    tape_health.json says healthy (computed when missing). healthy=False: every tape built (n=None) or the first n per generator.
298	    original_only=True restricts to k < DESIGN_N[tf] (the tapes of the first build, locked ones included when healthy=False)."""
299	    n = DESIGN_N[tf] if n is None and healthy else n
300	    out = []
301	    for g in sorted({_tape_gen(p) for p in all_tape_folders(tf, gen)}):
302	        fs = all_tape_folders(tf, g)
303	        if original_only: fs = [p for p in fs if _tape_k(p) < DESIGN_N[tf]]
304	        if healthy: fs = [p for p in fs if read_health(p)["healthy"]]
305	        if n is not None: fs = fs[:n]
306	        out.extend(fs)

309	
310	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the pass rule (FINDINGS section 7) as go_no_go-shaped items
311	def null_tape_check_from_diffs(real_diff, diffs, session_same_sign_min=PASS_RULE["session_same_sign_min"]):
312	    """diffs = {'gmm': [...], 'segment': [...], 'session': [...]} (one diff per certificate tape). Returns (passed, checks, summary):
313	    checks are (ok, value) pairs like harness.go_no_go's; passed = real diff > gmm p95 AND > segment p95 AND the session tapes
314	    carry the real sign in >= 75% of tapes."""
315	    q = lambda v, p: (round(float(np.nanquantile(v, p)), 2) if len(v) and np.isfinite(v).any() else None)
316	    ch, summ = {}, {}
317	    for g in ("gmm", "segment"):
318	        v = np.asarray(diffs.get(g, []), dtype=float); p95 = q(v, 0.95)
319	        ch[f"null_tape:real_diff>{g}_p95"] = (real_diff is not None and p95 is not None and real_diff > p95, p95)
320	        summ[g] = dict(n=int(len(v)), p50=q(v, 0.5), p95=q(v, 0.95), real_pct=(round(float(100 * np.nanmean(v < real_diff)), 1) if len(v) and real_diff is not None else None))
321	    v = np.asarray(diffs.get("session", []), dtype=float)
322	    same = float(np.nanmean(np.sign(v) == np.sign(real_diff))) if len(v) and real_diff is not None else None
323	    ch[f"null_tape:session_same_sign>={session_same_sign_min}"] = (same is not None and same >= session_same_sign_min, round(same, 3) if same is not None else None)
324	    summ["session"] = dict(n=int(len(v)), p50=q(v, 0.5), p95=q(v, 0.95), same_sign_share=(round(same, 3) if same is not None else None))
325	    summ["null_tape_diff_inr"] = {g: {"p50": summ[g]["p50"], "p95": summ[g]["p95"]} for g in ("gmm", "segment", "session") if g in summ}
326	    return all(v[0] for v in ch.values()), ch, summ

328	
329	def null_tape_check(real_diff, tf, rules, controls=False, draws=H.CONTROL_DRAWS, label="L1", verbose=False):

332	    and the session sign share. Returns (passed, checks, summary); summary['per_tape'] holds every tape's result. Tape numbers
333	    never enter the ledger. Call it only after the candidate's real-tape ledger row exists (the tapes are not a search space)."""
334	    per, diffs = [], {}
335	    for g in ("gmm", "segment", "session"):
336	        diffs[g] = []
337	        for folder in tape_folders(tf, g):
338	            r = evaluate_rule_list(folder, rules, controls=controls, draws=draws, label=label)
339	            r.update(gen=g, k=_tape_k(folder)); per.append(r); diffs[g].append(np.nan if r["diff"] is None else r["diff"])
340	            if verbose: print(f"  {g}_{r['k']}: diff {r['diff']} kept_share {r['kept_share']}", flush=True)
341	    passed, ch, summ = null_tape_check_from_diffs(real_diff, diffs)
342	    summ.update(tf=tf, real_diff=real_diff, per_tape=per, tape_set="certificate (healthy, first DESIGN_N per generator)")

# importance: FINDINGS (DESIGN_PANEL quant-ml-canon-feature-importance, both judges' fixes)

**What this study is.** The feature-vocabulary pass: which clusters of as-of columns (base design + the 61 extended columns handed here by the regime-breaks, regime-states, motif-shapelet and rocket-probe judges) carry information about the L1 outcome under the harness splitter; the shortlist of at most 8 clusters per timeframe that the gate studies may draw features from, frozen in the ledger before the phase-3 gate studies (gate_family, llm_round1, regime_gate; the H1-H5, session_stop, llm round 0, rocket and exit_policy searches preceded it and were not restricted to it: 'Repair', issue 1, 

## Definitions (fixed before the numbers)

```
Importance study library (DESIGN_PANEL: quant-ml-canon-feature-importance, both judges' fixes; feature hand-offs from
regime-breaks, regime-states, motif-shapelet, rocket-probe). Every definition below is fixed before any number is looked at.

Feature set        harness.design(T) (base as-of columns, one-hot text, 0/1 booleans) + the 61 extended as-of columns of
                   features_ext/<tf>/ext_features.parquet joined on setup_i. Columns with > 40% NaN on IS rows dropped and listed;
                   constant columns dropped; exact duplicates (|Spearman| > 0.999 on IS) dropped, the first kept; of a two-level
                   one-hot the second level is dropped (its complement carries the same information). Missing indicators
                   `<col>__na` for every kept column with a NaN on IS, de-duplicated by NaN pattern (one indicator per pattern,
                   named after its first column; the covered columns are listed). Median imputation uses the TRAINING fold's
                   medians (bagging); xgboost sees NaN as such.
Label / weights    L1 binary (net > 0); sample weight = |net| winsorised at the training fold's 99th percentile, normalised to
                   mean 1; class balance by DecisionTreeClassifier(class_weight="balanced"). Test-fold weights for the weighted
                   log-loss: |net| of the test rows winsorised at the SAME training-fold p99, normalised to mean 1 on the fold.
Model              BaggingClassifier(DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=4 (3 and 5 as a sensitivity), min_weight_fraction_leaf=0.05,
                   class_weight="balanced"), n_estimators=300, bootstrap, oob_score) under harness.purged_splits (12 blocks).
tau                chosen INSIDE the training fold on the bagging's out-of-bag probabilities: the p_win threshold on the grid
                   0.05..0.95 (step 0.01) maximising the kept mean net subject to |net|-weighted winner recall >= 0.90.
Clustering         Spearman correlation on IS rows (pairwise-complete; undefined -> 0), distance sqrt(0.5 (1 - rho)), scipy
                   average linkage, the cut with the best silhouette (precomputed distance) over 20..40 clusters.
Representative     per cluster, by config-expressibility tier (0 = integer-valued / boolean / one-hot / card or fz field;
                   1 = ATR ratio or other dimensionless; 2 = raw points / levels), then coverage, then centrality (mean |rho| to
                   the cluster's members).
Clustered MDA      per fold, the features of a cluster are permuted JOINTLY on the test rows (same row permutation for every
                   member, missing indicators included), 5 permutations; recorded per fold: the increase in OOF weighted log-loss
                   (primary: the pass rule and the ranks) and the decrease in the OOF kept-vs-skipped mean-net difference at the
                   fold's tau (harness.metrics, controls off; secondary, reported with its own ratio). Mean and std across the 12
                   folds; a cluster passes MDA when mean > std (log-loss).
MDI                per fold forest: sum over trees of feature_importances_ / n_trees, summed per cluster, averaged over folds.
SFI                each cluster alone (its members + indicators), same folds, same weights, same tau rule; its OOF gate is a
                   ledger row (family importance/sfi).
Stability          the per-fold, per-permutation OOF probabilities are kept per row, so the log-loss MDA is re-computed on the
                   rows of each period (minute: calendar years 2022 (with 2021-10..12), 2023, 2024, 2025; 5minute: halves
                   2021-10..2023-09 and 2023-10..2025-12); a cluster ranks top-8 in >= 3 of 4 years (minute) / in both halves
                   (5minute) or it is not shortlisted. The models are the 12 fold models (trained on the other 11 purged blocks).
Orthogonal check   PCA on the standardised (IS-median-imputed, z-scored) IS features; a bagging of the same shape on the PC
                   scores; scipy.stats.weightedtau between its MDI per component and the eigenvalues.
Interactions       xgboost max_depth 3, 200 rounds, eta 0.05, the same folds, on the top-40 features by clustered MDA (clusters
                   in MDA order, members in MDI order); shap.TreeExplainer(...).shap_interaction_values on the OOF rows; pairs
                   ranked by mean |interaction|; the top 5 pairs carry the gain-weighted median split point of each feature over
                   the tree paths where both features occur (all 12 fold boosters pooled).
```

Constants: trees 300, min_weight_fraction_leaf 0.05, main depth 4 (sensitivity (3, 5)), permutations per fold 5, tau grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.01, weighted winner recall floor 0.9, silhouette range 20..40 clusters, stability top-8, interactions on the top-40 features, 5 pairs; xgboost depth 3, 200 rounds, eta 0.05. Every model fit uses `harness.purged_splits` (12 blocks, purge by the L1 exit bar, 3-session embargo); nothing is fitted on OOS rows; OOS labels and features are never read.
